sources.verification: Author-hosted scan downloaded successfully; printed pp.203-204 rendered with pdftoppm and visually read. PDF text layer contains only cover metadata. No OCR or snippet was used to verify the criterion.
sources.needed_implication: For a smooth geometrically connected genus-two curve over a DVR fraction field of residue characteristic three, epsilon=3. The first three displayed invariant ratios in the maximal ideal yield two components meeting once; the last two ratios integral make both components smooth. This is compact-type stable reduction and therefore potential good reduction of the Jacobian.
sources.application: For t=-B^5/A^3 with 3|A and 3 not dividing BC, m=v3(t)<=-3. The five criterion valuations are 12,18,33,18,15, so all exact inequalities hold.

sources.needed_implication: For an abelian variety over a finite extension of Q_p and a prime ell different from p, trivial inertia on T_ell is equivalent to good reduction.
sources.application: The quadratic twist of J by nu_real has unramified T7 at p=3 or5; hence it has good reduction. Its two-torsion is unramified, and quadratic twisting by [-1] does not change two-torsion.
